title: [master] - Calculate Calendar reports missing from Work/Machine Center Cards and missing filter fields on request pages
summary: The Calculate Calendar reports are now accessible from Work Center and Machine Center Cards through a new processing action, and their request pages include additional filter fields for Work Center Group Code and Work Center No.
key_points: Added area(processing) with calendar actions to Work Center and Machine Center Cards
Extended RequestFilterFields on Calculate Machine Center Calendar report with Work Center No.
Extended RequestFilterFields on Calculate Work Center Calendar report with Work Center Group Code
Users can now access calendar reports directly from card pages using RunPageOnRec
Improved filtering capabilities on calendar report request pages
